info.description: One downloadable publication on /publications/ — a club newsletter, a magazine edition or an e-newspaper issue. ⚠⚠ THIS IS THE LIST THE SCHOOL ADDS TO. A new e-newspaper is one new row here; nothing else needs touching. ⚠ `href` IS THE SCHOOL'S OWN URL — a PDF on its server or a Google Drive viewer link. Every one was transcribed from the school's live page, not composed. Do not invent a link to fill a gap: a row with no file is worse than no row. ⚠ `group` DECIDES WHICH BAND IT APPEARS IN, and `displayOrder` its position within that band. The school's own order is preserved — it is NOT a ranking, so do not re-sort by date.
